text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian parliament's sub-committees start discussing the 1997 budget draft behind closed doors.
- Tunisian Industry Minister Slaheddine Bouguerra ended a three-day visit to Libya. Workshops set up to identify fields for joint ventures between the two countries.
- Tunisia's exports rose 3.1 percent during the first nine months of 1996 compared to the same period last year. Imports fell 0.3 percent.
